verses.text: I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O LORD, will I sing.

segments.text: I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O LORD, will I sing.

verses.text: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.

segments.text: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.

verses.text: I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.

segments.text: I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside;

verses.text: A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked person.

segments.text: A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked

verses.text: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.

segments.text: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.

verses.text: Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.

segments.text: upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.

notes: 101.6 in a…: or, perfect in the way

verses.text: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.

segments.text: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.

notes: 101.7 shall not tarry: Heb. shall not be established

verses.text: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the LORD.

segments.text: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the LORD.
